# AI Contribution Policy

The use of AI tools in preparing contributions to SonoLink is permitted.
Regardless of how a contribution is produced, the contributor remains fully
responsible for it, and all contributions are held to the same standard of
review.

## Understanding your contribution

Contributors must be able to explain and justify any code, issue, or pull
request they submit without relying on an AI tool to do so. If a maintainer
asks a question about a contribution and the contributor cannot answer it
directly, the contribution was not ready to be submitted.

Contributions must be directed and reviewed by a human throughout their
preparation, not merely approved at submission. Pull requests that appear to
have been generated and submitted without meaningful human involvement will
be closed.

## Communication with maintainers

Issue descriptions, pull request descriptions, and responses to maintainers
must be written by the contributor in their own words. Maintainers need
assurance that they are communicating with the person responsible for the
work, not relaying questions through the contributor to an AI tool.

Contributors may quote AI-generated output where it provides relevant
context, provided that the quoted material is clearly marked as AI-generated,
presented in a quote block, and accompanied by the contributor's own
explanation of its relevance. Quoted material should be brief.

## Non-native English speakers

Contributors may use AI tools to correct grammar in their own writing.
Contributors who are more comfortable writing in another language are
encouraged to do so and to include a quoted translation alongside the
original text, rather than relying on AI-generated text in place of their
own.

## Rationale

Low-quality AI-generated contributions impose a disproportionate burden on
maintainer time, and contributions that are not understood by their authors
often introduce problems that surface only after merge. This policy is not
intended to discourage the use of AI tools, but to ensure that a contributor
remains accountable for the work submitted under their name.

## Enforcement

SonoLink maintainers reserve the right to close issues or pull requests that
do not comply with this policy, to hide comments believed to be
AI-generated without disclosure, and to restrict contributors who repeatedly
or clearly violate this policy. This policy may be revised as circumstances
require.
